verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents an official MCP server that connects AI tools directly to meeting data (fireflies-docs-34, fireflies-probe-3). A tools overview covers read-only and action tools such as share, move and soundbite (fireflies-docs-50, fireflies-docs-42–44). An OAuth integration needs no API keys and lets users query their Fireflies data from ChatGPT (fireflies-docs-30, fireflies-docs-8, fireflies-docs-24). missing for 10: explicit evidence of Claude or generic MCP-client setup with OAuth, named MCP tools for search, transcript retrieval and action items, independent or hands-on corroboration.
